currentKnownProblems.summary: Task-scoped context pack is about 8-10s on the mounted WSL repository.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Prefer bounded status/session paths; revisit performance only with an explicit trust/cache design.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Explicit live graph and context reads remain filesystem-sensitive.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Warm cache first and opt into broad live diagnostics deliberately.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Tool-host child process launch can return EPERM while direct commands pass.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Run the command directly, then record it through validation run --direct-result.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Release artifact git-status preflight and full dev Docker workspace copy can exceed useful latency or fail on mounted WSL workspace-local state.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Use a clean ext4 clone for release artifacts; direct /workspace artifact attempts can fail if local-only untracked state such as .claude/ is present.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Historical HADARA-dev package smoke timeout incidents are mitigated by isolated smokeProjectRoot and per-step timeout reporting.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Package smoke/recycle now default to 300s per step for npm/recycle paths and report timeoutStepIds; use explicit `--timeout` only for a reviewed release exception.

This baseline does not supersede T-0667 through T-0669; it carries them forward for session resume until a first-class validationBaseline.rollup schema is introduced.
